name: Würstelstand Reutte
kurzbeschreibung:
**Sausage Stand Reutte in Reutte**

Discover the authentic Tyrolean taste at the **Würstelstand Reutte** in the charming town of **Reutte**. Whether you're craving a classic **Leberkäse** with mustard, a hearty **Käsekrainer**, or a crispy **Brez’n** with sweet toppings, this local favorite offers a quick, delicious bite. A perfect stop after exploring the scenic **Lechtal** or before heading to the nearby **Reschenpass**. Try it—you won’t regret it!
